sourceRule: Keep exact original panel photograph and visible chrome nut; do not draw a replacement circular mount or rail.

mechanism.appearance: ivory rounded handle, brushed metal stem, dark pivot collar; retain approved v1 color/material family
mechanism.animation: discrete frames with 220ms short snap; no translation of mount

switches.ref: BOTH ON L / NORMAL / BOTH ON R

acceptance: The chrome hex bezel must remain photo pixels visible in all detents
Photo-matched lever overlays use nine independently authored vector views
Changing detents never translates or rotates the mount or photo
Touch, mouse, and keyboard must retain current state-change logic
verification: coordinate candidate by inspection of source panel and source native aspect ratio; screenshot QA and user sign-off pending
